title: Funding Desk Memo: Code-Item Hold under Ordinance or Law Coverage on the Reconstruction Final Draw
content:
The code-item hold on the final draw of a Reconstruction contract keeps out the owner's share of the code items the building official requires, which the carrier's ordinance or law coverage pays, once they are completed and incurred, only up to its limit. The limit is the ordinance or law limit recorded on the linked claim file under Insurance Claim Services; the code items are the contract's signed code-required change orders.

**Carrier-funded.** A final draw is carrier-funded when its funding route, set by the base draw rule from the linked claim file, is not the customer: the claim file has a dwelling payment the carrier issued to the company directly (contractor direct), by a check naming the insured and the company (insured two-party), or into the mortgagee's loss-draft account (mortgagee loss draft). On any other final draw the customer funds the draw.

**Rule.** On a carrier-funded final draw:

- when the contract carries signed code-required change orders whose total exceeds the linked claim file's ordinance or law limit and that limit is above zero, the part of their total above the limit is held;
- when the claim file carries no ordinance or law coverage, a limit of zero or none recorded, the whole of their total is held;
- otherwise no code amount is held, because the work is complete at the final draw and the coverage pays the code items in full.

On a final draw that is not carrier-funded no code amount is held, because the customer funds the draw.

## Cases (hypothetical figures, carrier-funded final draw)

| Signed code-required change orders, total | Ordinance or law limit on the claim file | Code-item hold |
|---|---|---|
| $6,400.00 | $5,000.00 | $1,400.00 |
| $6,400.00 | $6,400.00 | none (the total does not exceed the limit) |
| $6,400.00 | $9,000.00 | none |
| $6,400.00 | zero, or none recorded | $6,400.00 |
| none signed | any | none |
